personas.name: Dona Maria
personas.summary: Understood little of what the company does and couldn't find a way to talk to anyone. The home page is too wide for the phone and the menu text is too small and too light.

goals.notes: The headline talks about 'innovative cloud solutions' and the text below is lorem ipsum; she couldn't tell what is being sold.

goals.goal: Find out how much it costs
goals.notes: Didn't recognize 'Pricing' in a Portuguese menu; reached the plans by trial and error. Saw 'R$ NaN/mês' on the home page and different prices on the plans page.

goals.goal: Find a phone or WhatsApp number to talk to someone
goals.notes: The contact page only has a form; there is no phone or WhatsApp. She gave up.

personas.name: Rafael
personas.summary: Found the plans quickly, but couldn't create an account: the free trial link leads to a page that doesn't exist.

goals.goal: Compare the plans and understand each one's limits
goals.notes: The Starter plan limit shows up as '{{plan.limit}} usuários'.
'Começar teste grátis' leads to a 404; the home page's 'Get started' button does nothing.

goals.goal: Find the documentation or a technical page
goals.notes: There is no link to documentation; 'Blog' goes nowhere.

personas.name: Lucas
personas.summary: The home page has no navigable headings and the contact form can't be submitted with the keyboard.

goals.goal: Understand what the company offers by navigating headings only
goals.notes: The main headline is a styled div, so the screen reader doesn't announce it as a heading.
Fields have no label (placeholder only) and 'Enviar' is a div that can't receive focus.

findings.title: The home page doesn't say what the company sells
findings.description: The hero is a generic slogan followed by lorem ipsum. Someone who doesn't know the company leaves without knowing whether it's hosting, storage or something else.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #2: match between system and the real world

evidence.snippet: Soluções inovadoras em nuvem para o seu negócio / Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet…

findings.suggestion: Replace it with a concrete sentence, such as 'Store and share your company's files securely, from R$ 29/month' (in Portuguese).

findings.title: English menu label ('Pricing') for a Brazilian audience
findings.description: The rest of the site is in Portuguese; people who don't read English didn't recognize 'Pricing' as prices.
findings.suggestion: Rename it to 'Planos e preços' on every page.

findings.title: Inconsistent price across pages
findings.description: The home page shows 'R$ NaN/mês' and the plans page mentions 'from R$ 19/month', but the cheapest plan costs R$ 29. This breeds distrust.

evidence.snippet: R$ 29/mês … Na página inicial dizemos "a partir de R$ 19/mês".

findings.suggestion: Use a single source for prices and show the same value on every page.

findings.title: No phone number or WhatsApp
findings.description: The only way to get in touch is a form. For people who prefer to talk to a person, this is a blocker.
findings.suggestion: Show a phone number and WhatsApp at the top of the contact page and in the footer of every page.

findings.title: It's impossible to create an account
findings.description: The home page's 'Get started' button calls a function that doesn't exist, and 'Começar teste grátis' leads to a 404 page. There is no other way to sign up.
findings.suggestion: Create the sign-up page and point both buttons to it.

findings.title: Main headline isn't a heading for screen readers
findings.description: The highlighted text is a div with a large font; people navigating by headings can't find it.

findings.title: Contact form can't be submitted with the keyboard
findings.description: The fields have no label (only a placeholder, which disappears while typing) and 'Enviar' is a div with no focus and no button role.
findings.suggestion: Use a visible <label> on each field and <button type="submit">Enviar</button>.

findings.title: Form confirmation isn't announced to screen readers
findings.description: After submitting the contact form, the message "Mensagem enviada com sucesso!" appears on screen, but it isn't in a status/alert region. The screen reader announces nothing and Lucas doesn't know whether the message was sent.
findings.suggestion:
Keep the region on the page from the start with role="status" (e.g.

) and fill in the text on submit.
